message: Player_7 says they checked player_5 on night 3, but player_5 was killed that night, so that claim is hard to test. Player_8, you said player_7 checked you on night 1, but player_7 says that check was on player_10. Which night was your check, player_7? Vote-wise I'm open for now and want a concrete answer before anyone is lynched.

Both player_3 and player_10 put a visit on player_7 on night 2, and that fits the save. player_7, you held the last check on night 3, so say plainly what you'd check on a split and when. player_8, what exactly did player_7 tell you about night 1?

My trailseer follow on night 2 was player_9, and they visited player_4, who was then struck down by a sigil. If player_9 is a real investigator, the check must come from a visit, so I want to see who they say they checked. player_9, which night did you check and on whom?

player_4, I'm not going to dispute your follow; I'm not the one who visited your door. I'm the Vigilante, and I held fire on night 1, so I shot no one. player_3 and player_4 can't both be right, so I'd test which of them is lying before anyone votes.

I'm player_5, and I checked player_8 night 1: Not suspicious. player_8 says the sigil was theirs, which fits. player_4 and player_3 contradict each other about a visit to player_4's door. Who can tell me which of their two claims has a witness? Until that's settled I won't vote on either.
(passed)

player_3, yes, I followed player_7 on night 2, so you saw me there. player_7, that night I saw you go to player_8, which fits your check. But last night I followed you and you visited no one, so the night-3 check on player_5 didn't happen. Which night did you actually check?
Yes, I went to you last night, player_4. Nobody else came to your door that I saw. I'm not showing more than that yet, so let's see whose claims hold up.

Yes, player_3, I followed player_7 on night 2, so I did visit them. My follow that night showed player_7 going to player_8, not anyone going to player_5. Last night I followed player_7 again and they visited no one, so a check on player_5 from them didn't happen. player_7, which is it?

player_7, you said your last check would go on player_5, but player_5 died to the wolves that night. What did that check read, and who did you visit on night 3? Nobody can test the investigator claim until you answer that.

My night 5 follow on player_6 saw no visits, so player_6 has still given us nothing. player_8 is the only one with a role claim we can test, so I'll follow player_8 tonight and see whether any visit shows up. If it shows nothing either, I'd vote player_8 on the day 6 vote.
(passed)

player_4, your claim is the problem: a follow shows where the followed player went, so your result should read as player_3 going to someone, not as a visit to your door. Quote the exact text and say whether it named a destination. player_6, if you protected player_10 on night 1, nobody attacked them, so that save proves nothing either way.

player_10, I did not visit anyone on night 2 for a trailseer to see; I had a check on player_8 that night, so I was out. I have no checks left, so my night 1 and 2 reads on player_10 and player_8 are all I have, both Not suspicious. Your trailseer claim is testable: who did you follow on night 3?
Sharing my night 2 follow: I followed player_9 and they went to player_4, nobody else. player_9, if you checked someone last night, who was it? Player_2 is dead, so that check can't be tested now.

player_4's follow claim only says player_3 went to them, and player_3 denies holding any follow. Only one player can hold the Trailseer, so player_4 needs to say what they can prove. player_3, which role do you hold? Your answer narrows who could have visited player_4's door.

player_10, you went to player_7 on night 2. What did you do there, and what came of it? player_7, your night-3 check on player_5 never got a chance to come back, so what did you learn from the other checks? I'd vote player_10 today until they answer.

I'm the trailseer. Night 1 I followed player_6, who went to player_7. Night 2 I followed player_9, who went to player_4. player_9 claimed investigator, so a check on player_4 would have come back Suspicious. Living players, who did you check or follow last night?

I followed player_9 last night and they went to player_4, who was then struck down by a sigil. Player_9, if you're the investigator, who did you check last night? Your claim is only useful if you name a target.

Two different nights are in play for the check on player_8. player_7 says night 2, and player_8 says night 1. player_10's follow puts player_7 at player_8 on night 2, which fits player_7's account. player_8, what night was the check, and what did you say to player_7 then?

Yes, I came to your door last night, player_4, and I'm keeping what I did there to myself for now. Going to you tells you nothing about whether you're a wolf. If you're the Trailseer, who else did you follow, and where did they go?

player_4, I did not follow anyone and I did not visit you last night. Whoever you think visited you, it wasn't me, so your claim doesn't fit. Who do you think followed you, and what else did you learn?

player_7 said last night they would check player_5, but they went nowhere that night, so that check did not happen. Their night-2 check on player_8 and the night-3 plan don't line up with that. I'd vote player_7 unless someone can show why their check claims hold.

Night 2 is mostly settled: player_10's follow and player_7's check both put player_7 at player_8. Player_3, your watch saw three visitors, so which one was the wolf carrier? Player_7, the night-3 plan you announced is still the open part, so give the one-line version of what you did that night.

player_4, your follow and visit wording still conflicts; a follow shows where the target went, so ask player_3 where they went that night, not whether they came to you. player_8, the sigil claim fits the record, so check it against player_6's protection on night 1, which could have saved player_1.
(passed)

player_4, I won't say what I did at night, so I'm not going to call your follow false. My own watch never shows in my result, so a visit to your door could be real. Let's test the claims instead: player_8 says the sigil was theirs, and player_5 and player_6 each claim a role. Those three should be checked against each other before anyone votes.

Someone I saw went to player_7 on night 2, and that someone was player_10. player_7 says they checked player_10 on night 1 and it read clean, so player_7 should explain why player_10 went to them the next night. I would vote player_10 today on that visit.

player_4, I did not go to your door on night 1, so the visit you describe cannot be real. A follow result naming me is false, and that's a fact I can stand on. Tell us your claimed role and exactly where your night 1 follow went, and why you think I'd be the one at your door.
I'm trailseer, and I'll say it since the trail matters. I followed player_6 last night and they visited player_7. Player_7, do you have anything to say about that visit?

Player_3 and player_4 can't both be right, and the watch result is the harder fact: if player_3 watched player_4 and saw no one, the follow of player_3 going to player_4 is what needs a second source. I'd test player_4 on who else they followed. Player_8's sigil claim fits my check, which read not suspicious on player_8. I'm not voting yet.

Player_7 said they checked player_5 last night, but I followed player_7 and they visited no one. Either the check didn't happen or player_7 is not telling the table the truth about night 3. player_7, which was it?

Yes, I was at your door last night, player_4, and nothing came to me that I know of. I'll keep the why to myself for now. Player_6 and player_8 both made claims, so let's see who backs them up before we vote on anyone.

I'm the sigilist, and I placed no sigil on night 4 or any other night, so player_1's sigilist claim is false. Both my sigils are still unused. player_1, if you sigiled player_3, name the sigil result and what player_3 did that night. I'd vote player_1 today.

I'm the trailseer. My follows: night 4 player_1 went to player_3, night 5 player_6 visited no one. player_6, you haven't claimed anything, so what did you do on nights 4 and 5? I'd vote player_6 today unless they give a checkable claim.

Both wolves are dead, so the Necromancer is one of player_6 and player_8. My night 5 follow of player_6 showed no visits, so I have no evidence on them yet. player_8, your sigilist claim names no target on nights 1 to 4, while my follows show player_7 going to you on night 2, which fits a check rather than a sigil. Who wants to explain why they claim a sigil but never used one?

player_4, I'm not going to back either side on the follow wording yet. player_3, if you watched player_4, which door did your watch see empty, and did anyone come to you? A clear answer from both of you would settle more than another round of wording.
(passed)

player_7, you planned a night-3 check on player_5 but haven't said what it read. Did you check them, and what came back? Player_5 is dead now, so that result is the one claim we can still weigh against the rest.

Since I claimed trailseer on the record: night 1 I followed player_6 and they visited player_7. Night 2 I followed player_9 and they visited player_4, who was the chanteuse. That fits player_9 checking player_4, so their investigator claim has some support. Nothing else gives me a reason to vote yet.

player_10, I checked you on night 1 and you read Not suspicious. Night 2 I checked player_8, also Not suspicious. I had no checks left on night 3, so my earlier plan to check player_5 was wrong and I shouldn't have said it. Nobody visited me that night as far as I know, so your no-visit result is consistent with that.

My vote if it were held now is player_1. On night 4 I followed player_1 and they went to player_3, the one the wolves killed that night. That doesn't prove a wolf, but it's the first concrete lead I have. player_6 and player_8, what did you do on night 4?

player_10, I'm not hiding. I'm the Speculator, with no visit on night 1, and I'm holding my pick. A lynch on being quiet on day 2 is thin. The real test is player_5's not-suspicious check and player_8's sigil claim, since only one of those can be checked against the sigil that struck player_1.

player_10, you're pinning a Necromancer read on me from one sigil death, but a sigil on a wolf is exactly what happened to player_1, so the night-one death doesn't single anyone out. I'd rather see player_8 and player_5 face a direct check on each other's claims before anyone votes.

Last night I followed player_6 and they visited no one. That doesn't clear them, since a held action looks the same. player_8, you say you kept sigils for nights 1 to 4, so name the night you would have used one and why you didn't. I'm not voting anyone without a reason yet.

Yes, I'm the trailseer. My follow on player_7 is a visit to them, so I did come to them on night 2 and 3, and player_3's night-2 list has me in it. On night 3 player_7 visited no one, so the check on player_5 they announced didn't happen. player_7, how do you explain that?

The record says player_1 was struck by a sigil, so player_8's claim fits. The night-1 pack target could not die, which fits the necromancer, not player_10 as a wolf. player_4 and player_3: one of you is lying about the visit, so give the exact wording of the result and of the follow.
